prompt:
3D highly rendered animation, soft 3D CGI look. Exactly four characters: Barnaby, Hazel, Anne and Baba. Only one Barnaby is in the frame. Subtitle-free, no logo, no watermark.

REFERENCES: @Image 1 gives Barnaby's head, antlers and colours and @Image 6 gives his full body in profile facing right; @Image 2 gives Hazel; @Image 3 gives Baba and @Image 4 gives Anne, both full body; @Image 5 is the location. Every Barnaby reference gives identity only, never size or crop: Barnaby stays at about 42 to 50 percent of the frame height, full antlers inside the frame with clear headroom.

CHARACTERS: Barnaby: chubby moose upright on his two hind legs like a person, red knit sweater with ribbed cuffs; antlers dark chocolate-brown, slightly darker than his fur, about 1.8 times his head width, short round prongs; giant round matte anthracite nose about half as wide as his face, short thick caramel-brown muzzle ending right behind the nose, big round amber-copper eyes, thick brown brows. Hazel: tiny chibi chipmunk, round head about 45 percent of her body, one dark chocolate forehead stripe, flat mint scarf, bushy S-curved tail that stays a big bushy S-curve the whole time, plump cream cheeks, two very big glossy solid black eyes. Baba: large moose father upright like a person, dark chestnut fur with grey grizzle, thick dark brows, half-closed eyelids over amber eyes, grey beard, round gold-rimmed glasses, plain forest-green knit sweater with a round ribbed collar; symmetric dark chocolate velvet antlers about 2.1 times his head width, four short thick round-tipped prongs per side; blunt face-coloured muzzle, giant round matte anthracite nose. Anne: moose mother upright like a person, no antlers, smooth round head, big round ears, dark chocolate-brown fur with a cream belly, amber irises, thick mustard-yellow knit shawl without fringe tied at her chest; blunt face-coloured muzzle, giant round matte anthracite nose. FORBIDDEN: any tail, tuft or tail-like bump on Barnaby; a small or shiny nose on Barnaby; Baba's antlers on Barnaby; white eye-whites on Hazel; antlers or buds on Anne; a patterned sweater on Baba; human fingers on any character; a second Barnaby; a fifth character; a second hazelnut.

LIGHT: silver full moon gives a thin cool rim light from the upper back; four paper lanterns give one soft, even, constant golden light that warms the faces. Barnaby's fur stays warm caramel-brown and his sweater deep red, Baba's sweater forest green, Anne's shawl mustard-yellow; the night is deep blue, never black.

SUBJECT & ACTION: Barnaby stands at the left of the picture in front of the long table in a three-quarter view facing the picture-right, one forearm resting on the tabletop, a red maple leaf already stuck to the red sleeve of that arm with an amber syrup smear, already there from the very first moment. Hazel is on his shoulder on the left side of the picture carrying one small smooth capless hazelnut, no bigger than her own head. Anne stands next to him, a little to the right of the middle of the table, and Baba stands at the right end by the bell pole, his forehoof resting against the cord.
Seconds 0 to 1.5: Hazel runs down Barnaby's forearm onto the tabletop carrying the hazelnut in both paws and hurries along the table among the pie, the bowl of cranberries and the corn cobs to the middle of the table.
At about second 1.5 she sets the nut down in the middle of the tabletop with a soft tap and gives it one or two quick gentle pats with her paw, a small gift gesture, her mouth closed the whole time; then she looks up at Anne with a small proud look, her eyes locked on Anne's face.
At about second 2.0 Anne smiles, her eyes on Hazel, and says warmly, her lips moving to the words, 'Thank you, Hazel.' while Hazel listens with her mouth closed, her eyes on Anne.
From about second 3.0 Hazel sits beside the nut with both paws empty and the nut stays in the middle of the table; Barnaby and Baba watch her with soft smiles. Barnaby's antlers stay on his head the whole time.

SCENE: four round white paper lanterns hang still on one twine rope above the table, from the top of the tall wooden bell pole on the right to the maples on the left; a long wooden table with a golden pie, a bowl of cranberries, two corn cobs and a loaf of bread, with round tree-stump stools around it, already there from the very first moment; a brass bell on a bracket on the bell pole at the right end of the table with one short braided cord hanging straight down; a moonlit meadow of red and burgundy maples and fallen red leaves, a deep blue sky, no snow.

CAMERA: a steady medium wide shot of Barnaby, Anne, Baba and the middle of the table, single continuous take from second 0 to 4.0, no cut. One slow smooth push-in from second 0 to second 3.0, then the camera holds: Barnaby grows from about 42 to at most 50 percent of the frame height and stays there; the middle of the table stays inside the frame. Barnaby's full antlers stay inside the frame with clear headroom above them the whole shot (and every other character's antlers too), at least 25 percent of the frame height above the tallest antlers.

SOUND: only natural on-set sounds: a dry night breeze, quick tiny paw steps on the wooden table, a soft tap of the nut on the wood and one or two tiny pats, a faint fabric rustle, each word heard once, Barnaby warm young male voice, Hazel tiny bright girl voice, Anne warm motherly voice, Baba warm low father voice, one line at a time.
